name: Mattresses and box springs

comps.spec: Hundreds of steel coil springs (open or pocketed); the wire gauge varies by model (the Serta Trelleburg lists 15.5 gauge, with no unit printed)
Heavy steel border rod, about 4–5 mm, around the spring unit
comps.loc: Top and bottom edges of the spring unit

comps.spec: Polyurethane and memory foam layers, 5–25 cm — padding, cushions and insulation
comps.loc: Top layers; the whole core in foam mattresses

comps.spec: Quilted ticking and polypropylene dust cover
Pine frame and slats in the box spring
Wire grid and torsion springs in the box spring
comps.loc: Box spring, on the wooden frame

comps.spec: Powered adjustable bases only: mains power supply, 100–240V AC in and 29V DC 2A out, 58W (TEMPUR-Ergo Smart base)
comps.loc: Between the wall plug and the control box

comps.spec: Head and foot lift motors on powered bases (TEMPUR-Ergo Smart: limited to about 2 minutes of use in any 18); children and pets can be crushed in the moving parts
comps.loc: Head and foot sections of the base

comps.spec: Control box on powered bases: takes power from the supply and has ports for the head and foot motors (lift and massage)

notes: Many cheap foam mattresses have a glass-fibre fire barrier inside the cover: don't cut or wash that inner cover, and don't sleep on a torn one. Damp mattresses grow mould; leave them.
